REQ-001.statement: The system shall allow a customer to initiate a laundry session for a specific machine by scanning a QR code located on that machine.

REQ-002.statement: The system shall allow customers to pay for laundry cycles using a digital payment method within the application.

REQ-003.statement: The system shall send a push notification to the customer's device when their laundry cycle is complete.

REQ-004.statement: The system shall provide a web-based dashboard for laundromat owners and staff.

REQ-005.statement: The owner dashboard shall display the real-time status of all machines in a selected location.

REQ-006.statement: The owner dashboard shall provide access to revenue reports.

REQ-007.statement: The owner dashboard shall display maintenance alerts for machines that have faulted.

REQ-008.statement: The system shall track and report the status of each machine, including 'idle', 'running', and 'out of order'.

REQ-009.statement: The system's IoT controllers shall use the MQTT protocol to communicate status updates to the backend.

REQ-010.statement: IoT controllers shall publish a status update at least every 10 seconds.

REQ-011.statement: The system shall use Stripe Connect for payment processing to handle fund settlement to individual laundromat owners.

REQ-012.statement: The system shall provide a Progressive Web App (PWA) to allow customers to use the service without installing a native mobile application.

REQ-013.statement: The customer application shall display a visual map of the laundromat, color-coding machines by status: green for available, yellow for in-use, and red for out-of-order.

REQ-014.statement: The system shall physically start a machine's cycle within 5 seconds of a successful payment confirmation.

REQ-015.statement: The system shall allow customers to complete a transaction as a guest without creating an account.

REQ-016.statement: The system shall provide an optional customer account that allows access to features like loyalty points.

REQ-017.statement: The system shall implement a loyalty program for registered customers.

REQ-018.statement: Registered customers shall earn one loyalty point for every full dollar spent (e.g., a $3.50 purchase earns 3 points), and can redeem 100 points for a free standard wash.

REQ-019.statement: The system shall offer a monthly subscription plan ('Spin Pass') for customers.

REQ-020.statement: The 'Spin Pass' subscription shall provide unlimited standard washes at a single, designated location for a monthly fee of $25.

REQ-021.statement: 'Spin Pass' subscribers shall receive a 50% discount on premium cycle types.

REQ-022.statement: The system shall send a reminder notification to a customer if their completed laundry has not been collected within 5 minutes of the cycle finishing.

REQ-023.statement: The system shall support applying an idle fee for laundry not collected after a pre-defined duration has passed since the cycle's completion.

REQ-024.statement: Idle fees shall be billed in full-minute increments, where any partial minute incurs the full per-minute charge (e.g., 90 seconds of idle time is billed as 2 minutes). The rate shall be configurable by the owner, with a suggested default of $0.25 per minute.

REQ-025.statement: The idle fee feature shall be configurable (enabled/disabled) on a per-location basis by the laundromat owner.

REQ-026.statement: The owner dashboard shall include a maintenance log for each machine.

REQ-027.statement: The system shall implement role-based access control (RBAC) for the owner dashboard to restrict access to data and functionality based on user role.

REQ-028.statement: The 'Owner' role shall have full access to all data and functionality for all locations associated with their account, including aggregate views.

REQ-029.statement: The 'Manager' role shall have full access to all data and functionality, but only for their specifically assigned location(s).

REQ-030.statement: The 'Attendant' role shall be able to view machine status and change a machine's status to 'out of order' by creating a maintenance log entry, but shall have no access to financial data.

REQ-031.statement: The system shall allow customers to register and authenticate using an email address and password.

REQ-032.statement: The system shall allow customers to register and authenticate using their Google account (social login).

REQ-033.statement: The system shall allow customers to register and authenticate using their Apple ID (social login).

REQ-034.statement: The system shall enforce Time-based One-Time Password (TOTP) two-factor authentication (2FA) for all owner dashboard users.

REQ-035.statement: The platform shall collect a 7% service fee from each transaction, with the remainder settling to the laundromat owner's connected account.

REQ-036.statement: Payouts of collected funds to laundromat owners shall occur on a two-day rolling basis.

REQ-037.statement: The system shall allow customers to request a refund for a transaction through the application.

REQ-038.statement: The owner dashboard shall allow authorized users (Manager or Owner) to approve or deny pending refund requests.

REQ-039.statement: The IoT controllers must be able to buffer at least 4 hours of status events to handle network connectivity outages.

REQ-040.statement: The system shall allow customers to start machines during an internet outage.

REQ-041.statement: The customer-facing application (native and PWA) shall be compliant with Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA.

REQ-042.statement: The customer-facing application shall support English and Spanish languages.

REQ-043.statement: Machine status changes must be reflected in the customer and owner applications within 2 seconds of the corresponding event being published by the IoT device.

REQ-044.statement: The owner dashboard shall achieve initial data load in under 3 seconds.

REQ-045.statement: The public-facing APIs shall achieve a monthly uptime of at least 99.9%.

REQ-046.statement: The system shall allow customers to join a virtual waitlist for a specific type of machine (e.g., front-load washer) when none are available.

REQ-047.statement: The system shall notify the first customer in a waitlist queue via push notification when a matching machine becomes available.

REQ-048.statement: A customer notified from the waitlist shall have 5 minutes to start a cycle on an available machine. If they do not claim a machine in time, their spot is forfeited and the next person in the queue is notified. If there are no more users in the queue, the machine becomes generally available.

REQ-049.statement: All financial transaction data must be retained for a minimum of 7 years.

REQ-050.statement: Raw machine telemetry event data shall be purged after 90 days, but daily aggregated telemetry data shall be retained indefinitely.

REQ-051.statement: All network traffic between clients (app, dashboard, IoT) and backend servers must be encrypted using TLS 1.3.

REQ-052.statement: Personally Identifiable Information (PII) must be encrypted at rest using AES-256.

REQ-053.statement: The system shall allow authorized users to reserve a group of specific machines for a defined time window in a single operation.

REQ-054.statement: Reserved machines shall be blocked from general availability in the customer application during their reservation window.

REQ-055.statement: A 50% cancellation fee shall be charged if a machine reservation is cancelled less than two hours before its scheduled start time, based on a yet-to-be-defined reservation cost.

REQ-056.statement: The owner dashboard shall provide a revenue analytics page with visualizations.

REQ-057.statement: The system shall allow owners to export revenue and transaction data to a CSV file.

REQ-058.statement: The customer API must be rate-limited to 100 requests per minute per user.

REQ-059.statement: The system shall allow administrators to define different laundry cycle types (e.g., Normal, Delicate, Heavy-Duty) with associated prices and durations.

REQ-060.statement: The system shall allow a laundromat owner to send promotional notifications to registered customers of a specific location.

REQ-061.statement: The system shall generate a maintenance alert visible within the owner dashboard when a machine reports a fault.

REQ-062.statement: The system backend shall maintain a local payment ledger to ensure the owner dashboard can display revenue data independently of the payment processor's API latency.

REQ-063.statement: The system API must support at least 500 concurrent users per location without performance degradation.
